questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Cystoisospora belli?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Oocysts in stool; shedding may be intermittent.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Oocysts in stool; shedding may be intermittent. Concentration and modified acid-fast staining around 400×; further sampling or molecular methods can assist difficult cases.
